name: Open the nearby Bluetooth group chat
description: From the Groups tab, tapping the Bluetooth nearby group opens its chat screen with the message box ready. No message is sent, because messages in that group are public broadcasts.
details: With a seeded location fix (Groups legs proven by contacts.groups.tiers), tapping the Bluetooth mesh tier row pushes the geohash channel chat: the new geohash-chat:mesh probe pins that the MESH channel specifically opened (not a location tier), with its composer surface rendered — navigation and render assert only, deliberately NO message send (mesh messages are public broadcasts); back out to the wallet
